milestone: Milestone 20 - Staging Safety Gate and Human-Reviewed Pilot Readiness

checklist_criteria.name: Contradicted Answer Prevention Gate
checklist_criteria.description: No known contradicted claim or holding inversion may receive the verified_supported badge.
checklist_criteria.evidence: Pipeline badge aggregator strictly checks contradicted_claims_count == 0; Policy 3 reduced contradiction FAR to 10% (1/10) and Policy 4 to 0% (0/10); answers with contradicted claims receive rejected_answer badge.

checklist_criteria.name: Non-Supported Claim Promotion Prevention Gate
checklist_criteria.description: No partially supported, unsupported, or not-evaluated claim may receive the verified_supported badge.
checklist_criteria.evidence: RAGResult.verification_badge enforces 100% claim-level support requirement; partially supported claims yield qualified_answer and not_evaluated yields unverified_answer.

checklist_criteria.name: Reproducible Failure Documentation
checklist_criteria.description: All benchmark failures, false acceptances, and disagreements must be documented in versioned frozen JSONL files.
checklist_criteria.evidence: Frozen datasets evaluation/rag/milestone20_staging_claims.jsonl (40 claims) and evaluation/rag/milestone20_policy_comparison.json document exact cases and confusion matrices.

checklist_criteria.name: Automated Regression Test Suite Pass Rate
checklist_criteria.description: All existing unit and regression tests must pass without regressions.
checklist_criteria.evidence: 315/315 automated repository tests passing across all previous milestones.

checklist_criteria.name: Corpus Boundaries and Non-Authoritative Legal Disclaimers
checklist_criteria.description: The system must explicitly identify the corpus boundary (782 Supreme Court 2024 judgments) and provide non-authoritative disclaimers.
checklist_criteria.evidence: API response models and UI contract in apps/web/README.md require explicit non-authoritative research disclaimers on every response.

checklist_criteria.name: Independent External Legal Review
checklist_criteria.description: Blind review of representative evaluation claims by qualified independent legal professionals.
checklist_criteria.evidence: External legal review could not be secured; evaluation/rag/milestone20_blinded_review_pack.jsonl (30 claims) prepared but review status remains explicitly PENDING_EXTERNAL_REVIEW. No simulated or developer-curated labels claimed as independent.

checklist_criteria.name: Live CPU Generation Latency and Timeout Gate
checklist_criteria.description: Live local LLM generation on reference CPU hardware must complete reliably under interactive timeout thresholds (<60s).
checklist_criteria.evidence: Live Ollama execution with phi3.5:latest on full multi-passage legal prompts timed out (>180.0s), demonstrating pure CPU execution of 3.8B parameter models is unviable without GPU acceleration or strict context budgeting.

checklist_criteria.name: Verifier Policy Trade-Off Stability on Staging Set
checklist_criteria.description: The verifier policy must achieve acceptable precision (>70%) without catastrophic false rejection (>50% FRR) on held-out staging claims.
checklist_criteria.evidence: On 40 staging claims, Policy 3 suffered 16.67% non-supported FAR (admitting 4 partial claims) with 58.33% precision, while Policy 4 achieved 100% precision but suffered a 90.0% false rejection rate (9/10 supported claims rejected). Neither policy is mature for autonomous staging.

blockers_summary: Independent external legal review is pending.
Real CPU-only local generation for 3.8B LLM exceeds 180s timeout on multi-passage contexts.
Policy 4 semantic over-conservatism causes a 90% false rejection rate on valid legal claims, while Policy 3 allows 40% of partially supported claims to pass.
recommendations_for_next_milestone: Retain system in strictly supervised internal development mode.
Complete formal external legal review with licensed advocates using the blinded review pack.
Introduce lightweight 1B SLMs (e.g., Llama 3.2 1B or Qwen 2.5 0.5B/1.5B) or GPU offloading for sub-10s live generation.
Calibrate NLI neutral thresholds to reduce Policy 4 false rejections without lowering contradiction veto guards.
